This latest fix comes a l … Read the full story at The Verge. ]]> Verge Staff https://www.theverge.com/27944/gta-6-news-trailers-rockstar-games 2026-08-27T19:53:42-04:00 2026-08-27T16:01:56-04:00 It’s been over a decade and two console generations since GTA V came out, and its sequel is still a work in progress. GTA VI has faced multiple delays, with developer Rockstar Games bumping back its predicted release date twice, eventually shifting to November 19th, 2026 , a full year after its originally planned fall 2025 release window. Early official glimpses offered a look at the game’s protagonists , Jason and Lucia, who players will navigate around Vice City as outlaws on the run after a job goes south. Preorders have opened for the digital code-only game, offering the $79.99 standard edition and $99.99 Ultimate Edition on both PS5 and Xbox Series X / S . Rockstar Games has also responded to “CyberLeek” posts that showed sequences of the game, calling them heartbreaking and saying, “…this is obviously not how we intended for you to see the game after all this time.” At about the same time, the leakers released yet another clip . Now a half-hour “extended look” has arrived full of gameplay slices and cutscenes that’s available for viewing on Netflix , as well as all over other social media channels in reaction videos before it hits YouTube at 9PM — here are some of our first impressions .
